CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.document_storage_organization_id(object_name text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when split_part(object_name, '/', 1) ~
      '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
    then split_part(object_name, '/', 1)::uuid
    else null
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_active_organization_role(target_organization_id uuid, allowed_roles text[])
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.organization_memberships membership
    where membership.organization_id = target_organization_id
      and membership.user_id = auth.uid()
      and membership.status = 'active'
      and membership.role = any(allowed_roles)
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_active_organization_member(target_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.organization_memberships membership
    where membership.organization_id = target_organization_id
      and membership.user_id = auth.uid()
      and membership.status = 'active'
  );
$function$
